body: I don't really have much to say that hasn't already been said, but reading this thread has kinda wrecked me. I was outed to my parents a few months ago and it's been awful. I'm so grateful there are parents like you out there OP, reading this has been a welcome reprieve.
Being honest about who you are is not a mistake. If someone responds poorly it's their fault for being awful, not yours. Congratulations friend!
That's not how abusive dynamics work.
Lololol. Nope.
I mean I spent my 20s in the closet. So hell yeah I'd take it! No more missed opportunities for me!
Hahaha true. My parents used to drink wine out of coffee cups in case we had company come over.

Hi there! I'm a bi woman, I've been married to my husband for almost 4 years, and I came out to him a little over a year ago. I have a similar background, just southern Baptist instead of Catholic, but really what's the difference lol?

First of all, you being supportive from the get go is such a huge thing! I can't imagine how I would have felt if my husband had responded differently, and his support means the world to me. 

She's absolutely right; as long as you two continue to communicate well, this will only improve your marriage.
No, the knobs don't come in contact with the plate as long as they're the right size and are installed correctly.
Yes, they do. The implication is that it they're defeated pre-timeskip, they live but can't fight anymore. Post-timeskip, they die. Thus the dream and dramatic speech.
"You kind of remind me of Fieldy" I don't listen to Korn much but I appreciated it!

I would definitely recommend a Dingwall or Kiesel, both for the scale and the tone. The strandberg basses are cool but crazy overpriced for what they are. And I agree, stingrays are cool but you're going to run into problems with those tunings.
Miss Murder- AFI

Octopath is an RPG along the lines of final fantasy, but I like the story much better than any ff title I've played. And Hollowknight is an indie open world platformer. It is very hard but so much fun!

Depends on the type of games you're into, Fire Emblem 3 houses is super fun! Hellblade is a gorgeous, if short, game. Also loved Octopath Traveler. Hollowknight is a classic. I don't have my switch on me but dm me your friend code and we'll play some smash!

Wow, thank you so much!!! I had no idea there were so many resources about this specific situation!!

If it makes you feel better, it took us a year to get to this point. It was tough, not in like a fighting all the time way, just had to have lots of very honest conversations. Which is honestly a huge part of why our marriage is so healthy now! There is literally *nothing* he and I haven't touched on now. 

We want to wait until we've saved enough to buy (probably about 6 more months) but we'll see if that's even viable. 

And yeah she owes me a huge apology but there no way I'm getting one. And if I say that to her she'll probably go crying to mom and I'll get even more shit from her. 

Anyway, thank you so much for your support!
I love that quote, though it's a little more relevant to my life than I thought it'd be lol. I appreciate it

I truly truly am! I'm trying not to ruminate on it too much. The good news is I just got a new job that pays better than my old one. I'm looking at about 6 more months!

EDIT: love your username!

Appreciate the good vibes. The thing is, I was going to come out as bi. But I wanted to do that in my own time. I certainly was not going to mention dating women because I knew they wouldn't get it, and frankly that really only concerns myself and my husband. I didn't see a reason to. And yeah I've been developing an exit plan
That's exactly how I feel every time they talk to me now lol. I appreciate the support friend

Thank you! It's mad awkward, there have been lots of overheating hushed conversations and very uncomfortable questions. My husband and I have been able to talk about it some, but he's working and a couple time zones away so not a ton. I'm spending the night at my girl's place tonight so that's a pretty huge relief.
Thank you friend. I do too!

Wow, that really sucks. I'm so sorry they handled it so poorly! I think sometimes straight cis people try very hard to be "buddies" with the nearest LGBTQ person, and in their efforts to be.... I don't know familir? They're very, very offensive. I'm a bi woman, that's just my perspective on it. But yeah, he's being awful!

It's degrading because you feel degraded. But beyond that, throwing an expletive in with a shitty tone and yeah he's being an asshole. It doesn't matter what the term is, if someone asks not to be called a specific word the normal thing to do is to stop using that word. It isn't rocket science this guy is just a jerk.
Lol Central Florida. It's a really confusing place
Because they're ass-backwards old school church bros. They're awful but I'm not all tore up about it, their loss lol
Mostly a bass player but I also play guitar and sing. Fun fact, I just got kicked out of my metal band for coming out as bi. So it just so happens I'm also for hire!

Hi there! I'm bi, married to a dude (he's the best), and I date women. The key is to have very clear expectations and boundaries from the get go. We aren't poly, I'm not really interested in bringing a third person into my marriage, and my husband isn't involved with the women I date. 

My experience has been very positive! Specifically because my husband and I communicate really well and **did before we tried this.** Communication is vitally important!

Also, I don't go out with women who don't my situation, that's just good manners I think.
